phases.name: Harness and contract freeze
phases.objective: Initialize long-horizon state, scaffold repo, freeze contracts and concrete acceptance commands.

phases.name: Source acquisition
phases.objective: Build P0 source adapters, immutable raw persistence, health checks and golden fixtures.

phases.name: Domain pipeline
phases.objective: Build parsers, normalization, entity resolution, snapshots/diffs and core event semantics.

phases.name: Signals and proof
phases.objective: Build signal rules/scoring/watch matching and the core proof artifact.

phases.name: API, CLI and delivery
phases.objective: Expose application services through FastAPI and signalctl with export/delivery behavior.

phases.name: Human UX
phases.objective: Build the offer-specific UI workflow against frozen contracts and required system states.

phases.name: Integration and release
phases.objective: Rebase/merge lanes, run fresh-checkout full replay and final readiness.
